title: LLL outputs the reduction base, and the first vector is not guaranteed to be the global shortest
summary: LLL returns a basis that satisfies the reduction conditions. Different implementations or parameters can yield different reduced bases of the same lattice.
applies: Integer lattice; convention for row vectors as bases
detail: When checking a candidate short vector, you should also check its integer coefficient combination relationship, norm and original problem conditions.
boundary: Seeing that the shorter first line does not assert that the shortest vector problem has been solved exactly by the name of LLL alone.
relevance: Avoid taking the first line returned by the reducer as the only answer to the question.
